metas.name: 1. Heads or Tails
metas.description: Queen Dagmar interrogates the Dreamland townsfolk to find out who's hiding Bean's body. Meanwhile, Luci reconnects with his estranged father.

metas.name: 2. Fish Out of Water
metas.description: While Bean and the crew try to find a place to dispose of the body, King Zøg battles cops, robots and an angry mob to rescue his three sons.

metas.name: 3. Electric Ladyland
metas.description: After Malfus foretells an ominous prophecy, Bean and Mora travel to Steamland to reconnect with Zøg — but first they must decode a cryptic message.

metas.name: 4. I Hear Your Noggin, But You Can't Come In
metas.description: Zøg, Bean and Mora search for a way into the Freak Show to free Derek, Bear Boy and Freckles. Then, Elfo and the crew elude a persistent Bad Bean.

metas.name: 5. Who Shot Elfo?
metas.description: Tormented by the mystery of his death, Elfo takes an ill-advised trip to figure out who shot him. Meanwhile, Luci hides Bad Bean's head from Satan.

metas.name: 6. The Stience of Homemade Lightning
metas.description: In the forgotten city of Maru, Bean meets the Queen of the Crones, who encourages her to harness her new special power. Later, Elfo falls for a friend.

metas.name: 7. Gimme Gimme Shock Treatment
metas.description: As the townsfolk prepare for war, Bean and Zøg land in the Twinkletown Asylum, where the princess makes a stunning realization about her destiny.

metas.name: 8. The Battle of Falling Water
metas.description: A battle between the Dreamland army and Dagmar's forces may spell disaster for Princess Bean, unless she can defeat her greatest foe: herself.

metas.name: 9. Darkness Falls
metas.description: With the Crystal Caverns magic flowing throughout the kingdom, only Bean can stop power from falling into the wrong hands — if she can quit moping first.

metas.name: 10. Goodbye Bean
metas.description: With the fate of Dreamland hanging in the balance, a mother battles her daughter for beauty, power and immortality. But living forever comes at a price.
